fix: Hard allowlist for public provider error codes/stages, generic messages before persistence and recovery; read-only tenant-scoped trust endpoint, accessible per-connector proof view; no green without actual external data and security audit.

Every trust status derives from authenticated original tenant connector store and persisted version-checked provider test only.
Provider safe-tests and configured links never mean real production records, compliant data location or independent security certification.
